name: Jean Behra
features: compact muscular build, close-cropped dark hair, weathered square face, plastic prosthetic right ear, jaw set hard
bio: A former motorcycle champion who attacked every race as though it were the last lap, and lost an ear doing it. Beat the entire works Ferrari and Mercedes entry at Reims in 1952 in a Gordini — the greatest French result of the era — but never won a championship Grand Prix in fifty-two starts. Punched his Ferrari team manager at Reims in 1959 and was sacked; died a fortnight later on the AVUS banking.
